column7: \class TermSig { \coerce | Sort : \Set | Symb : Sort -> \Set | domain {s : Sort} : Symb s -> Array Sort }
\data Term {S : TermSig} (V : S -> \Set) (s : S) | var (V s) | apply (f : Symb s) (DArray (\lam j => Term V (domain f j)))
| apply (f : Symb s) (DArray (\lam j => Term V (domain f j)))
\func subst {S : TermSig} {U V : S -> \Set} {s : S} (t : Term U s) (rho : \Pi {s : S} -> U s -> Term V s) : Term V s

\lemma subst-assoc {S : TermSig} {U V W : S -> \Set} {s : S} (t : Term U s) {rho : \Pi {s : S} -> U s -> Term V s} {tau : \Pi {s : S} -> V s -> Term W s} : subst (subst t rho) tau = subst t (\lam u => subst (rho u) tau)
\lemma subst_var {S : TermSig} {V : S -> \Set} {s : S} (t : Term V s) : subst t var = t
